It is famous for its beaches, bullfights and festivals. Spaniards are famous for their beauty. They have Mediterranean features, which means that they ... In Spain, most people live ... The Spanish love to eat ... In their free time, Spaniards love ... Spain is a fantastic country to visit. Its warm climate and passionate people make it a great place for a holiday.
exercises.instructionUz: Sayohat jurnali uchun Ispaniya va uning xalqi haqidagi maqolani to'ldiring (1-unit, 33-mashq). Ispaniya - Yevropaning janubi-g'arbidagi eng mashhur sayyohlik manzillaridan biri. U plyajlari, buqa janglari va festivallari bilan mashhur. Ispanlar go'zalligi bilan mashhur. Ularda O'rta yer dengizi chehrasi bor, ya'ni ular ... Ispaniyada ko'p odamlar ... yashaydi. Ispanlar ... yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi. Bo'sh vaqtida ispanlar ... yaxshi ko'radi. Ispaniya tashrif uchun ajoyib mamlakat. Iliq iqlimi va ehtirosli odamlari uni ta'til uchun ajoyib joyga aylantiradi.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA ShABLONI - boshi va oxiri
berilgan, o'rtasini to'ldirasiz.

11-BETDAGI 32-MAShQ QAYDLARI:
  Looks: black hair, brown eyes,
    not very tall
  Character: lively, friendly,
    sociable

    flats

  = O'rta yer dengizi chehrasi (qora

  teri).


⚠ 'WHICH MEANS THAT':

tasks.en: They have Mediterranean features, which means that they have got black hair, brown eyes and dark skin, and they are not very tall. They are lively, friendly and very sociable people.
tasks.uz: Ularda O'rta yer dengizi chehrasi bor, ya'ni ular qora sochli, jigarrang ko'zli va qoramtir terili, unchalik baland bo'yli emas. Ular jonli, samimiy va juda kirishimli odamlar.

tasks.en: In Spain, most people live in cities in small flats. They work in offices, shops and factories.
tasks.uz: Ispaniyada ko'p odamlar shaharlarda kichik kvartiralarda yashaydi. Ular idoralar, do'konlar va zavodlarda ishlaydi.

tasks.en: The Spanish love to eat seafood and omelettes. They usually have a light breakfast and a big lunch late in the afternoon.
tasks.uz: Ispanlar dengiz mahsulotlari va omlet yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi. Ular odatda yengil nonushta va tushdan keyin kech katta tushlik qiladi.

tasks.en: In their free time, Spaniards love going to cafes and clubs, and going out for dinner with friends and family.
tasks.uz: Bo'sh vaqtida ispanlar kafe va klublarga borishni, do'stlari va oilasi bilan tashqarida kechki ovqat qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.

tasks.en:
Spain is one of the most popular tourist destinations in the south-west of Europe. It is famous for its beaches, bullfights and festivals.

Spaniards are famous for their beauty. They have Mediterranean features, which means that they have got black hair, brown eyes and dark skin, and they are not very tall. They are lively, friendly and very sociable people.

In Spain, most people live in cities in small flats. They work in offices, shops and factories.

The Spanish love to eat seafood and omelettes. They usually have a light breakfast and a big lunch late in the afternoon.

In their free time, Spaniards love going to cafes and clubs, and going out for dinner with friends and family.

Spain is a fantastic country to visit. Its warm climate and passionate people make it a great place for a holiday.
tasks.uz:
Ispaniya - Yevropaning janubi-g'arbidagi eng mashhur sayyohlik manzillaridan biri. U plyajlari, buqa janglari va festivallari bilan mashhur.

Ispanlar go'zalligi bilan mashhur. Ularda O'rta yer dengizi chehrasi bor, ya'ni ular qora sochli, jigarrang ko'zli va qoramtir terili, unchalik baland bo'yli emas. Ular jonli, samimiy va juda kirishimli odamlar.

Ispaniyada ko'p odamlar shaharlarda kichik kvartiralarda yashaydi. Ular idoralar, do'konlar va zavodlarda ishlaydi.

Ispanlar dengiz mahsulotlari va omlet yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi. Ular odatda yengil nonushta va tushdan keyin kech katta tushlik qiladi.

Bo'sh vaqtida ispanlar kafe va klublarga borishni, do'stlari va oilasi bilan tashqarida kechki ovqat qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.

Ispaniya tashrif uchun ajoyib mamlakat. Iliq iqlimi va ehtirosli odamlari uni ta'til uchun ajoyib joyga aylantiradi.

exercises.explanationUz:
XAT TARJIMASI (to'ldirilgan):

18-iyul
Aziz Tony,
Mening ismim Steve Evans. Men o'n
besh yoshdaman va Angliyaning
Blackpool shahrida yashayman.

Oilamizda to'rt kishimiz: ota-onam
Bill va Karen, o'n ikki yoshli
singlim Gina va men. Otam -
O'QITUVChI. U boshlang'ich maktabda
ishlaydi. Onam mahalliy kasalxonada
HAMShIRA. Biz shahar markazidan yarim
soatlik masofada, chiroyli bog'li
katta UYda yashaymiz.

Maktabim uyimizdan taxminan IKKI
KILOMETR narida. Men har doim
VELOSIPEDDA boraman. Bu odatda
YIGIRMA DAQIQA oladi va yaxshi
jismoniy mashq. Odatda uydan SAKKIZ
YIGIRMADA chiqaman va maktabga
TO'QQIZGA YIGIRMA QOLGANDA yetib
boraman. Darslar TO'RTGA YaRIMDA
tugaydi. Uyga qaytganimda yengil
tamaddi qilaman, keyin UY VAZIFAMNI
QILAMAN. Undan keyin kechki ovqat
qilamiz, keyin TELEVIZOR KO'RAMAN.
Dam olish kunlari biz ko'pincha
MAShINADA PLYaJGA boramiz. U yerga
yetib borish deyarli BIR SOAT oladi,
chunki ba'zan tirbandlik bo'ladi,
shuning uchun juda sekin bo'lishi
mumkin. Lekin biz qarshi emasmiz.

Xo'sh, men haqimda shu. Iltimos, tez
orada javob yoz va o'zing haqingda
ayt.
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Steve


JAVOBLAR (rasmlardan):
  1 teacher  2 nurse  3 house
  4 two kilometres  5 bike (bicycle)
  6 twenty minutes  7 twenty past
  eight  8 twenty to nine  9 half
  past three  10 do my homework
  11 watch TV  12 beach  13 car
  14 hour


⚠ 'A PEN-FRIEND':

  = yozishma do'sti.


⚠ 'THERE ARE FOUR OF US':

  = biz to'rt kishimiz.


⚠ 'AGED TWELVE':

  = o'n ikki yoshli.


⚠ 'PRIMARY SCHOOL':

  = boshlang'ich maktab.


⚠ 'IT TAKES + VAQT':

  = ... vaqt oladi.


⚠ 'A SNACK':

  = yengil tamaddi.


⚠ 'A TRAFFIC JAM':

  = tirbandlik.


⚠ "WE DON'T MIND, THOUGH":

  = Lekin biz qarshi emasmiz.
  ⚠ 'though' gap oxirida = lekin.


⚠ 'THAT'S ALL ABOUT ME':

  = men haqimda shu.

tasks.en:
Dear Anna,

My name is Dilshod. I am fourteen years old and I live in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.

There are five of us in our family: my parents, my two brothers and me. My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. We live in a flat near the city centre.

My school is about one kilometre from our house, so I always walk. I usually leave home at half past seven and lessons finish at one o'clock. When I get home, I have lunch and do my homework. In the evening I watch TV or play football with my friends.

At the weekends, we often visit my grandparents in the countryside.

Well, that's all about me. Please write back soon.
Best wishes,
Dilshod
tasks.uz:
Aziz Anna,

Mening ismim Dilshod. Men o'n to'rt yoshdaman va O'zbekistonning Toshkent shahrida yashayman.

Oilamizda besh kishimiz: ota-onam, ikki akam va men. Otam shifokor, onam o'qituvchi. Biz shahar markazi yaqinidagi kvartirada yashaymiz.

Maktabim uyimizdan bir kilometr narida, shuning uchun har doim piyoda boraman. Odatda uydan yettiga yarimda chiqaman, darslar soat birda tugaydi. Uyga kelganimda tushlik qilaman va uy vazifamni qilaman. Kechqurun televizor ko'raman yoki do'stlarim bilan futbol o'ynayman.

Dam olish kunlari biz ko'pincha qishloqdagi buvi-buvamnikiga boramiz.

Xo'sh, men haqimda shu. Iltimos, tez orada javob yoz.
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Dilshod

sections.title: Photo File - Unit 3: Lost property letters

exercises.instructionEn: Read the model letter (card a - Anne Brown). Dear Sir/Madam, I lost my suitcase on flight DLT456 from New York to Heathrow on 5th August. It is a large rectangular blue suitcase. It is made of plastic and it has four wheels and a blue plastic handle. It also has one side pocket. Inside, there are some clothes, shoes and a camera. It has also got some documents in it. If by any chance someone has handed it in to the lost property office, please contact me on (0171) 6274731 after 6 pm any day. Yours faithfully, Anne Brown
exercises.instructionUz: Namuna xatni o'qing (a karta - Anne Brown). Hurmatli janob/xonim, Men 5-avgust kuni Nyu-Yorkdan Heathrowga DLT456 reysida jomadonimni yo'qotdim. Bu katta to'rtburchak ko'k jomadon. U plastikdan yasalgan, to'rtta g'ildiragi va ko'k plastik dastasi bor. Bitta yon cho'ntagi ham bor. Ichida kiyimlar, poyabzal va kamera bor. Ba'zi hujjatlar ham bor. Agar kimdir uni yo'qolgan buyumlar bo'limiga topshirgan bo'lsa, iltimos, har kuni soat 18:00 dan keyin (0171) 6274731 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling. Hurmat bilan, Anne Brown
exercises.explanationUz:
YO'QOLGAN BUYUM HAQIDA RASMIY XAT
- TUZILIShI:

  1 'Dear Sir/Madam,' - kimga
    yozayotganingizni bilmasangiz
  2 NIMA, QAYERDA, QAChON yo'qoldi:
    'I lost my suitcase on flight
     DLT456 ... on 5th August.'
  3 TAVSIF (sifatlar tartibi!):
    'a large rectangular blue
     suitcase' - o'lcham, shakl,
     rang
    'It is made of plastic' -
     material
    'it has four wheels and a blue
     plastic handle' - qismlar
  4 IChIDA NIMA BOR:
    'Inside, there are some clothes,
     shoes and a camera.'
  5 ILTIMOS + ALOQA:
    'If by any chance someone has
     handed it in ..., please
     contact me on ...'
  6 'Yours faithfully,' - 'Dear
    Sir/Madam' bilan juft (rasmiy)


⚠ 'YOURS FAITHFULLY' va 'YOURS
SINCERELY':

  Dear Sir/Madam → Yours faithfully
  Dear Mr Brown → Yours sincerely


⚠ 'IF BY ANY CHANCE':

  = agar tasodifan.


⚠ 'TO HAND IN':

  = topshirmoq.


⚠ 'LOST PROPERTY OFFICE':

  = yo'qolgan buyumlar bo'limi.


⚠ 'TO CONTACT SOMEBODY ON + RAQAM':

  = ... raqamiga bog'lanmoq.


⚠ 'A HANDLE':

  = dasta.


⚠ 'A SIDE POCKET':

  = yon cho'ntak.

Hurmatli janob/xonim,

Men 14-noyabr kuni Myunxendan Gatwickga BA 1432 reysida sayohat sumkamni yo'qotdim.

Bu to'rtburchak yashil, sariq, qizil va ko'k neylon sumka. Uning qora zamokli ikkita yon cho'ntagi, qora neylon yelka tasmasi va qora-ko'k dastasi bor.

Ichida qora teri g'ilofdagi videokamera, hamyon, kiyimlar va suvenirlar bor.

Agar kimdir uni yo'qolgan buyumlar bo'limiga topshirgan bo'lsa, iltimos, dushanbadan jumagacha soat 17:00 dan keyin (0597) 261436 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

Hurmat bilan,
Tim Jones

sentencePatterns.formula: X is one of the most popular [ot] in [joy].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Spain is one of the most popular tourist destinations in Europe.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ispaniya - Yevropadagi eng mashhur sayyohlik manzillaridan biri.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is famous for its beaches, bullfights and festivals.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U plyajlari, buqa janglari va festivallari bilan mashhur.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In their free time, Spaniards love going to cafes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bo'sh vaqtida ispanlar kafega borishni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are [son] of us in our family: ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are four of us in our family: my parents, my sister and me.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oilamizda to'rt kishimiz: ota-onam, singlim va men.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It takes nearly an hour to get there.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U yerga yetib borish deyarli bir soat oladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I usually leave home at [vaqt] and get to school at [vaqt].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I usually leave home at twenty past eight and get to school at twenty to nine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Odatda uydan sakkiz yigirmada chiqaman va maktabga to'qqizga yigirma qolganda yetib boraman.

sentencePatterns.formula: I lost my [buyum] on [reys/poyezd] from [joy] to [joy] on [sana].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I lost my suitcase on flight DLT456 from New York to Heathrow on 5th August.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men 5-avgust kuni Nyu-Yorkdan Heathrowga DLT456 reysida jomadonimni yo'qotdim.

sentencePatterns.formula: It is a [o'lcham] [shakl] [rang] [buyum]. It is made of [material].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is a large rectangular blue suitcase. It is made of plastic.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu katta to'rtburchak ko'k jomadon. U plastikdan yasalgan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Inside, there are some clothes, shoes and a camera.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ichida kiyimlar, poyabzal va kamera bor.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Please contact me on (0171) 6274731 after 6 pm any day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Iltimos, har kuni soat 18:00 dan keyin (0171) 6274731 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.
